title: Kind Words To The Partner (Michelle Grogan)
style: soft rock bongo trance earthy fusion 128bpm acoustic guitar bongo conga marimba shakers warm bass synth pads tribal claps happy chorus English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Partner had your back
Partner missed a ball
First words matter
Kindness wins the day

[Verse 1]
Nice try partner nice try
We will get the next one high
My bad my fault that one
I should have called the sun
Vamos vamos partner ready
Uno dos tres voice steady
No blame no shame no eye roll
We play together one whole

[Pre-Chorus]
Say it kind
Say it true
Say it kind
We pull through

[Chorus]
Kind words to the partner kind words to the partner
Nice try good try we got the next one
Kind words to the partner kind words to the partner
Vamos amigos we are one

[Verse 2]
If I missed I say my fault clear
If they missed I say no fear
Never sigh and never groan
Never leave them all alone
Uno dos tres patient kind
Mano blanda peace of mind
Great shot great shot every win
Positive talk lets begin

[Bridge]
Between points talk strategy
Never criticize the energy
What shall we try the next point
We plan together joint by joint

[Chorus]
Kind words to the partner kind words to the partner
Nice try good try we got the next one
Kind words to the partner kind words to the partner
Vamos amigos we are one

[Outro]
Say it kind
Say it true
Nice try partner
We pull through
